title: Velvet Hours
description: A slow-burn future-garage romance that opens with a beatless felt-piano chord bed and a breathing pad, then eases a swung 2-step kit underneath. Chopped diva numbers float over deep organ sub bass and sidechained swpad, building to a euphoric, nocturnal peak before melting back to piano and reverb.
